title: Ondo pinned products bento
description: A product showcase in a pale grey bento with 32px corners. On desktop the bento pins in the middle of the window while you scroll through it: on the left an accordion of white product cards (the open one shows a black icon tile, a 36px name, a serif description, a small availability chip, network dots and a dark button; the others are 90px rows with just the name), on the right three white figure cards (one wide, two halves) with serif figures, a purple outlined badge and chart slots. Each third of the scroll opens the next product, its card growing and its figures fading up. On phones every product is its own grey panel with the card and its three figures stacked.
notes: media slots: a chart per figure card; faint surfaces when empty
network logos are plain coloured dots (chart tokens) with the network's name for screen readers
desktop pins for about two window heights of scroll; needs JavaScript (motion) to follow the scroll
figures and descriptions read var(--ondo-serif) and fall back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-products
